architecture_summary: A PySide6 desktop GUI (main.py → MainWindow) that wraps the OpenCode CLI tool into a chat interface. The user types instructions which are sent to OpenCode via a QThread background worker (OpenCodeWorker in core/worker.py) running opencode.cmd run --format json. The JSON-streamed output is parsed for text/tool_use events and rendered as styled HTML in a QTextBrowser chat display. Static CLI queries (models, agents, sessions) use a generic ServiceWorker QThread wrapper (core/service_worker.py) wrapping static methods on OpenCodeService (core/opencode_service.py). Long-term agent memory is stored via SQLite in AgentMemory (core/memory.py). The .opencode/ directory contains OpenCode's own config, agent definitions, protocol specs, and automation tools (scheduler, CI monitor, issue monitor, genesis).

external: markdown>=3.10.2 (renders agent output as HTML in chat display)

known_gotchas.description: SQL query on line 90 uses string interpolation for session_id — SQL injection risk. Must escape or parameterize before production.
stop() uses taskkill /F /T /PID for Windows process tree cleanup — essential because shell=True spawns cmd.exe as parent. Never use .terminate() alone on Windows.
JSON parsing error on non-JSON lines (e.g. CLI noise) is silently swallowed with pass — debug output from opencode.cmd may be lost.
